user_story: As a user, I want to log in to my account using valid credentials so that I can access my account features. Acceptance Criteria: 1. Given the user navigates to the login page at 'https://automationexercise.com/login', they should see 'Login to your account' under the 'section' with id 'form'. 2. The user should be able to successfully log in with valid credentials by entering their email in the input with name 'email' and their password in the input with name 'password', then clicking the button with text 'Login'. 3. If the user enters invalid credentials, an appropriate error message should display, and the user should remain on the page.
